summary: Gains are firming into the afternoon: the Sensex is up about 400 points as heavyweights lead, while the Nifty holds modest gains near 22,750 and stock-specific buying shows up in small caps.

detail.leaders: ICICI Bank, Reliance, TCS, L&T, Kotak Bank, SBI; IT, PSU banks, Oil & Gas, Chemicals
detail.laggards: Hospitals and healthcare; Dr Reddy's; BSE
detail.tone: Stronger than 12:30: the Sensex headline has improved to about +400 from +299 at noon. The Nifty is around 22,750, up from 22,742.50 (+0.12%) at 12:00, so the Sensex is outpacing it.
watch: A close above 22,780 would reclaim Monday's level
